verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for Unity, which runs cloud services and AI tooling, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents retention settings, deletion workflows, or data-purge controls for user, project, or AI-assistant data. The Cloud Save spec only describes persisting state, and Services environments are logical test partitions; neither is a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
